faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Manager position at IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Project Manager position at IIT Gandhinagar is 20th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Manager role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Civil Engineering with a specialization in Geotechnical Engineering, along with specific minimum percentage requirements from graduation onwards and for 10th and 12th class.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Manager position will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Manager post at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online. Candidates need to apply through the official IIT Gandhinagar website.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Project Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is CON/10084/Advt0313 DATED 07.09.2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Manager position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Gandhinagar located?
faq.answer: IIT Gandhinagar is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Project Manager role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Manager role will be based on Institute norms.
